text: It’s probably my 4th return visit to MOS. I know there are many branches and outlets, but this is the most convenient branch. Fully sheltered from T21, Asok BTS, and MRT is right below. The staff are friendly. They accept reservations via WhatsApp too, which makes it a breeze for me. I make it a point to come back here for a general cleaning session every 6 months. Shout out to Dr Lani whom I have managed to speak to, a number of times giving me professional dental advice about the situation of my teeth.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

“The staff are very friendly and easy to talk to, making me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. The dentists are gentle and caring, taking great care during every procedure. It was a great experience from start to finish, and I am very happy with the service I received. The treatment was also great value for money. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for professional and friendly dental care.”

They went above and beyond expectations! They provided professional, useful advice. Prices were reasonable, service was efficient and polite. The location is convenient. The office is clean and fairly comfortable considering the price range. I am certainly going to use this dental clinic again, and I am recommending it to everyone I know.

I had very bad teeth; many were broken. I went to the MOS Clinic in the Interchange Tower, made an appointment, and got one immediately. I was given a precise treatment plan, the examination was thorough, and the problem was resolved within five weeks. All my teeth were extracted, and I received excellent care right away. My upper and lower dentures were made quickly.

The entire team consists of highly professional dentists, a friendly receptionist, and other staff members, all of whom are efficient, helpful, and courteous.
I would highly recommend that people go there if they have small or big teeth problems.

I went to get a cleaning and clear retainers since I lost my retainers for the millionth time. Retainers were done within the day and they accepted my delta dental insurance!! You pay first but they will give you the receipt and you just give that to your insurance company to receive the reimbursement. I was surprised. Also, always ask for Dr. Pajaree!! She’s very sweet and made sure to explain every step of the way to me.

Excellent first experience at MOS Dental Clinic

My very first cavity in 40 years – and MOS Dental Clinic had the honor of helping me. The cavity had already been diagnosed in the Netherlands, but I didn’t have time to get it treated before leaving for Thailand. After searching on Google, I decided to visit MOS Dental Clinic.

Since it was my first cavity, the staff took the time to clearly explain the procedure beforehand. I chose to have the treatment without anesthesia, and the dentist who treated me checked in often to make sure I was comfortable, which made me feel very reassured.

The whole experience was professional, caring, and much easier than I had imagined. I’m very happy with the treatment I received. Thank you so much, MOS Dental Clinic!

I had my teeth cleaned with Dr. Korkwan and couldn’t be happier with the experience. The dentist was very professional and gentle. I didn’t feel any pain during the cleaning, only a bit startled by the sound of the machine. The clinic is also very convenient to get to, just a few mins walk from BTS Asok. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality dental care in Bangkok
